fix: improve camellia version dialog editing (#68)

## Summary
- replace the version dialog `links` textarea with input-based editing
- show separate `Win32` and `Win64` link inputs for `WINDOWS` and save them as `X86` / `X64`
- switch `time_release` to a browser date-time picker and serialize it back to ISO

## Testing
